phrases.text: Proposition A is a referendum on a law the General Assembly already passed: a new congressional map.
Today, Missouri's eight congressional districts follow boundaries enacted in 2022.
In 2025, the General Assembly passed House Bill 1, which replaces those boundaries with new ones.
Missouri would still have eight districts.
A referendum petition put the law on the ballot, so voters will approve or reject it.
The State Auditor's fiscal note summary says state and local governmental entities estimate no costs or savings.
Missouri publishes no official argument against the proposition.
Missouri publishes no official argument for the proposition.
A yes vote will approve House Bill 1, which redraws the congressional district boundaries.
A no vote will leave in place the congressional district boundaries enacted in 2022.
